evidence.summary: UEA A100 checks threshold academic eligibility, then ranks eligible applicants by UCAT cognitive total when interview capacity is oversubscribed. There is no fixed UCAT cut-off, no academic points score and no A100 contextual adjustment. ApplySmart uses non-anomalous Home legacy /3600 interview-average data only to create a clearly labelled historical-normalised Home guidance estimate; International prediction is withheld because International-only historical UCAT data is missing.

eligibility.scope: Automatic banding applies only after the supported A-level or IB academic route passes, UCAT is present for the application cycle, English language evidence is resolved where required and the applicant is not a graduate-entry, Scottish, resit or country-specific international-qualification manual-review route.

scottish.manual_review_reason: UEA Advanced Higher BBB including Biology or Chemistry is recorded, but automatic Scottish eligibility is withheld because the current generic evaluator cannot safely enforce National 5 English B and Maths A thresholds.

map_override.description: UEA Preparing for Medicine participants who have confirmed programme engagement and meet UEA A100 minimum entry requirements receive a guaranteed interview.
map_override.applicant_facing_explanation: You meet the published criteria for a guaranteed interview through the UEA Preparing for Medicine Programme, subject to meeting the standard UEA A100 entry requirements.
map_override.confirmation_notice: Guaranteed interview — UEA Preparing for Medicine Programme
map_override.recommendation_badge_label: Guaranteed interview — UEA Preparing for Medicine Programme
map_override.notes: This override bypasses competitive UCAT interview-ranking output only after standard UEA A100 minimum eligibility requirements are met.

manual_review_routes: Scottish qualifications because National 5 grade thresholds need manual checking
A-level or GCSE resit applicants because UEA's resit rule depends on subject-level resit evidence
Country-specific international qualification equivalence without UEA verification
Alternative English-language evidence or IGCSE exception cases
do_not_infer: Do not create a fixed current-year UCAT threshold.
Do not score GCSEs, predicted A-level grades or achieved post-16 grades.
Do not reject SJT Band 3 or Band 4.
Do not apply contextual academic reductions, contextual UCAT uplift or contextual interview thresholds to A100.
Do not implement A104 Gateway Medicine or A101 Graduate Entry Medicine inside A100.
Do not use 2020 anomalous fields or unverified 2025 /2700 figures in runtime guidance.
Do not predict offers, interview performance or waiting-list outcomes.

score_model.basis: UCAT cognitive total after threshold eligibility. ApplySmart Home guidance uses a historical-normalised median of non-anomalous Home interview-average UCAT values from 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024; 2020 and 2025 anomalous rows are excluded.

excluded_reasons: 2020 FOI row contains an official-source low/high anomaly including 1390.
2025 research reports average and median UCAT values above the stated 2700-point scale.

conversion_policy.execution_rule: Normalised values calibrate ApplySmart Home historical guidance only. Raw /3600 values are source evidence and never runtime comparison values.

historical_series.notes: Home reference is the median of non-anomalous Home interview-average UCAT values normalised from /3600 to /2700.

presentation.pool_label: Home and International applicants follow the same published methodology, with separate place quotas.
presentation.selection_summary: UEA checks threshold academic eligibility first, then ranks eligible A100 applicants by UCAT cognitive total when interviews are oversubscribed. GCSEs, predicted grades and contextual status are not scored.
presentation.timeline_selection_summary: Academic thresholds were checked before UCAT-ranking guidance was applied. No contextual A100 adjustment or academic points score was used.

comparison_guidance.label: ApplySmart historical-normalised Home UCAT guidance
comparison_guidance.caveat: UEA does not publish or use a fixed UCAT cut-off. This guidance uses non-anomalous Home historical interview-average UCAT values normalised from /3600 to /2700 and is not a current threshold or guarantee.

official_candidate_decile_guidance.reason: Official Home historical interview averages remain raw /3600 source evidence. Runtime uses fixed ApplySmart-derived /2700 guidance boundaries from median calibration.
